text: Do your best impression of someone in this room for 30 seconds — group votes on accuracy.
Speak in an accent chosen by the group for the next 2 rounds.
Give a sincere compliment to every single person in the room, one by one.
Do 10 jumping jacks while singing the chorus of a song chosen by the group.
Talk in slow motion for the next 3 minutes — 1 sip each time you forget.
Let the person to your left write any caption on your last Instagram post (they show you before posting).
Show the group the most embarrassing photo on your phone.
Do your best model runway walk across the room — full commitment required.
Let the group give you a nickname you must use for the rest of the game.
Call a friend, say 'I have news — I'll explain tomorrow,' and immediately hang up.
Let each player draw one mark on your face with a washable marker.
Speak only in questions for 5 minutes — 1 sip per statement.
Let the group look through your camera roll for 30 seconds.
Do your best stand-up comedy bit — minimum 1 minute; group claps to pass.
Call someone and speak only in a foreign accent for 30 seconds.
Read the last text message from 3 apps on your phone — group picks which apps.
Hold a plank for 60 seconds — 1 sip per 10 seconds short.
Let the group post one Instagram story on your behalf — they write it, you approve before sending.
Impersonate a celebrity chosen by the group for 60 seconds without breaking character.
Deliver a 1-minute fake movie trailer narration for a film title the group invents.
Text your most recent ex 'I've been thinking about you' — show the group before sending.
Let the group change your phone wallpaper to anything they choose for the rest of the night.
Let the group compose and send one message from your phone to a contact they choose (content must stay SFW).
Share your last 5 Google searches with the group.
Let the group scroll your dating app for 30 seconds — no dating app = drink 3 sips.
Call a family member and sing Happy Birthday to them regardless of the date — full song, no stopping.
Post a photo on your main social media with a caption written entirely by the group — keep it up for 10 minutes.
Do a 30-second seductive dance directed at whoever the group picks.
Tell the group your most embarrassing story involving a romantic interest — minimum 2 minutes.
Demonstrate what you look like when you're flirting, live, targeted at whoever the group chooses.
